arStrings.szText: When you would be dealt fatal damage, instead you Heal to full Life, gain a Barrier for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2" * 100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, and Knock Back Close enemies. This can only occur once every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds.
